newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC shares soft ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: HSBC shares soft ahead of results.

text.p: Shares of HSBC Holdings Plc tended softer on profit-taking ahead of the announcement of the banking giant's 1996 results due later on Monday, brokers said.
HSBC shares eased HK$0.50 to HK$188.50 in late-morning on volume of 1.71 million shares worth HK$324.33 million. The shares moved in a range of HK$188.50 to HK$191.50.
Brokers said investors were seen taking profit ahead of the earnings report but downside was seen limited in the short run.
"The market is generally expecting HSBC to report encouraging earnings gowth of 22 to 24 percent," said Sean li, associate director at Amsteel Securities.
"The shares are seen an attractive buy as they are still trading at a discount to the market," Li said.

HSBC was trading at a prospective price/earnings (P.E.) ratio of 12 times for 1997 and 10 times for 1998, compared with the banking sector's average prospective P.E. ratio of 13 times for 1997, and 11.4 times for 1998, analysts said.
